quarterly_data.signal: Approval: the U.S. FDA approved Tecentriq (atezolizumab) and Tecentriq Hybreza in combination with a fluoropyrimidine and oxaliplatin for the adjuvant treatment of stage III deficient DNA mismatch repair (dMMR) colon cancer, the twelfth indication for Tecentriq in the US (company: the first approved adjuvant immunotherapy regimen for stage III dMMR colon cancer). The approval rests on the Phase III ATOMIC study (712 patients), in which adding Tecentriq to mFOLFOX6 reduced the risk of disease recurrence or death by 50% versus chemotherapy alone; 36-month disease-free survival was 86% versus 76%, with safety consistent with previous studies. Roche is pursuing further regulatory filings, including with the European Medicines Agency.
quarterly_data.figure: twelfth US indication; 50% risk reduction; 36-month DFS 86% vs 76%; 712 patients
